functions.name: pathTraceGI
functions.label: Path-traced GI
functions.help: Bounces light through the world volume (voxel paths with sun, sky and torches) and adds it to the image. Noisy: more samples cost more.
functions.signature: vec4 pathTraceGI(vec4 color, vec2 uv, float samples = 2, float bounces = 2, float strength = 1, float maxDistance = 32)

functions.name: rtAmbientOcclusion
functions.label: RT ambient occlusion
functions.help: Hardware rays around each surface darken corners and crevices.
functions.signature: vec4 rtAmbientOcclusion(vec4 color, vec2 uv, float radius = 1.5, float samples = 4, float strength = 0.8)

functions.name: rtReflections
functions.label: RT reflections
functions.help: Hardware-traced mirror reflections on one material class (1 water by default; -1 = every surface).
functions.signature: vec4 rtReflections(vec4 color, vec2 uv, float amount = 0.35, float material = 1)
